| Deploy key SSH content must be valid single-line SSH public key | validation | Key content contains newlines or fails SSH parsing |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| SSH is disabled in config | 422 | SSH is disabled | False |
| Cannot verify key content | 422 | Unable to verify key content | False |
| Same key already added to repo | 422 | This key has already been added | False |
| Key name already used in repo | 422 | A key with the same name already exists | False |

- **Key already exists for repo** → HandleAddKeyError → 422
